title: Applicability of premium taxes.
bodyText: Service contract provider fees shall not be subject to premium taxes. Contractual liability insurance policies shall be subject to premium taxes.
bodyHtml: [§481X-9]  Applicability of premium taxes.  Service contract provider fees shall not be subject to premium taxes.  Contractual liability insurance policies shall be subject to premium taxes. [L 2000, c 221, pt of §2]
